entries.text: You gain 400 experience points for returning Tandi.
entries.source_text: You gain 400 experience points for returning Tandi.

entries.text: 因为找回坦蒂你得到400点经验值。
entries.source_text: 因为找回坦蒂你得到400点经验值。

entries.text: To the south, you see an adobe wall surrounding a peaceful-looking village.
entries.source_text: To the south, you see an adobe wall surrounding a peaceful-looking village.

entries.text: 在南方，你看见一圈泥砖墙环绕着一个和平的村庄。
entries.source_text: 在南方，你看见一圈泥砖墙环绕着一个和平的村庄。

entries.text: A small shack is all that remains of this area. Fortunately, your records indicate a secondary entrance to Vault-15 there.
entries.source_text: A small shack is all that remains of this area. Fortunately, your records indicate a secondary entrance to Vault-15 there.

entries.text: 一个小窝棚是这个区域留下的唯一的东西。幸运的是，你的记录显示出那有进入15号避难所的第二个入口。
entries.source_text: 一个小窝棚是这个区域留下的唯一的东西。幸运的是，你的记录显示出那有进入15号避难所的第二个入口。

entries.text: You see a small building, with a series of tents nearby. The inhabitants look dirty and mean.
entries.source_text: You see a small building, with a series of tents nearby. The inhabitants look dirty and mean.

entries.text: 你看见一个周围有帐篷的小房子。那些居民看起来又脏又卑贱。
entries.source_text: 你看见一个周围有帐篷的小房子。那些居民看起来又脏又卑贱。

entries.text: You come across a medium-sized town. A wall of junked cars blocks easy entrance. A hazy smoke lies low over the town.
entries.source_text: You come across a medium-sized town. A wall of junked cars blocks easy entrance. A hazy smoke lies low over the town.

entries.text: 你遇到一个中等规模的小镇。用废车垒成的墙挡着简便入口。烟雾低沉地笼罩着小镇。
entries.source_text: 你遇到一个中等规模的小镇。用废车垒成的墙挡着简便入口。烟雾低沉地笼罩着小镇。

entries.text: To the south you see a large city. Outlying farms surround the town. There is much life in this desert oasis.
entries.source_text: To the south you see a large city. Outlying farms surround the town. There is much life in this desert oasis.

entries.text: 你在南方看见一个大城市。市区周围坐落着村子。这个荒漠绿洲中有许多生存者。
entries.source_text: 你在南方看见一个大城市。市区周围坐落着村子。这个荒漠绿洲中有许多生存者。

entries.text: You approach a dark and broken city. Little life can be seen. A stench of death surrounds the area.
entries.source_text: You approach a dark and broken city. Little life can be seen. A stench of death surrounds the area.

entries.text: 你抵达了一个又黑又破的城市。只能看见很少的活物。死亡的恶臭环绕着这个区域。
entries.source_text: 你抵达了一个又黑又破的城市。只能看见很少的活物。死亡的恶臭环绕着这个区域。

entries.text: A small building surrounded by a chainlink fence is to the north. Menacing guards in heavy armor patrol the area.
entries.source_text: A small building surrounded by a chainlink fence is to the north. Menacing guards in heavy armor patrol the area.

entries.text: 在北方有一个用锁链围起来的小屋。有重兵在这个区域巡逻。
entries.source_text: 在北方有一个用锁链围起来的小屋。有重兵在这个区域巡逻。

entries.text: A large crater sprawls to the north.
entries.source_text: A large crater sprawls to the north.

entries.text: 一个大的弹坑坐落在北方。
entries.source_text: 一个大的弹坑坐落在北方。

entries.text: Mutant guards can be seen to the northeast in front of a fortified location built into the side of the mountain.
entries.source_text: Mutant guards can be seen to the northeast in front of a fortified location built into the side of the mountain.

entries.text: 在东北方能看见变种人卫兵守在一个通向山脉的加强建筑附近。
entries.source_text: 在东北方能看见变种人卫兵守在一个通向山脉的加强建筑附近。

entries.text: A large, ornate building rises into the sky. A crowd of people walks aimlessly before it.
entries.source_text: A large, ornate building rises into the sky. A crowd of people walks aimlessly before it.

entries.text: 一座大型的，华丽的建筑通向天空。一群人在它前面漫无目的地行走。
entries.source_text: 一座大型的，华丽的建筑通向天空。一群人在它前面漫无目的地行走。

entries.text: You can see a warehouse to the north, with a moat of glowing goo around it.
entries.source_text: You can see a warehouse to the north, with a moat of glowing goo around it.

entries.text: 在北方你能看见一个仓库，带着一个流着发光黏液的护城河。
entries.source_text: 在北方你能看见一个仓库，带着一个流着发光黏液的护城河。

entries.text: A large, fortified factory, with graffiti-painted walls and threatening gun ports, looms ahead.
entries.source_text: A large, fortified factory, with graffiti-painted walls and threatening gun ports, looms ahead.

entries.text: 一个巨大的，被加强的工厂，带着有涂鸦的墙和致命的炮门，在前方隐约可见。
entries.source_text: 一个巨大的，被加强的工厂，带着有涂鸦的墙和致命的炮门，在前方隐约可见。

entries.text: The signs of gang activity are evident in the partially-rebuilt nightclub and tiny outposts here.
entries.source_text: The signs of gang activity are evident in the partially-rebuilt nightclub and tiny outposts here.

entries.text: 部分重建的夜总会和小型的警戒前哨是附近帮派活动的明显征兆。
entries.source_text: 部分重建的夜总会和小型的警戒前哨是附近帮派活动的明显征兆。

entries.text: In the heart of the city, a great library, fortified and restored, rises with forbidding yet graceful presence. You feel a sense of peace.
entries.source_text: In the heart of the city, a great library, fortified and restored, rises with forbidding yet graceful presence. You feel a sense of peace.

entries.text: 在城市的中心，一座大的被加强和重修的图书馆，令人陌生却又优雅地矗立着。你感到了和平的气息。
entries.source_text: 在城市的中心，一座大的被加强和重修的图书馆，令人陌生却又优雅地矗立着。你感到了和平的气息。

entries.text: A fenced village, patrolled by guards, waits defiantly to the south.
entries.source_text: A fenced village, patrolled by guards, waits defiantly to the south.

entries.text: 一个被围起来的村庄，被卫兵把守着，挑战似地坐落在南方。
entries.source_text: 一个被围起来的村庄，被卫兵把守着，挑战似地坐落在南方。

entries.text: You see a giant footprint in the ground. You search but find no other tracks in the area.
entries.source_text: You see a giant footprint in the ground. You search but find no other tracks in the area.

entries.text: 你在地上看见一个大脚印。你搜索了这个区域但却没找到其他足迹。
entries.source_text: 你在地上看见一个大脚印。你搜索了这个区域但却没找到其他足迹。

entries.text: Scorch marks and ashes cover the area.
entries.source_text: Scorch marks and ashes cover the area.

entries.text: 这个区域到处是被烧焦的痕迹和灰尘。
entries.source_text: 这个区域到处是被烧焦的痕迹和灰尘。

entries.text: This area looks like it was hit by a high-pressure firebomb.
entries.source_text: This area looks like it was hit by a high-pressure firebomb.

entries.text: 这个地方看起来被高压燃烧弹打击过。
entries.source_text: 这个地方看起来被高压燃烧弹打击过。
